title: KOR Activewear
subtitle: A custom e-commerce built from scratch. No Shopify, no React. Just PHP, MySQL and vanilla JS.
about:
What is KOR Activewear?

An e-commerce project built from the ground up without a framework. The point was to actually understand what the frameworks do: how a cart persists across tabs, how passwords get hashed properly, how a REST API hangs together. The frontend is vanilla JavaScript, the backend is a custom PHP API, and the database is MySQL.

challenge.title: The problem: building a store without a framework
challenge.description: React and Shopify hide a lot of plumbing. Doing it without them meant dealing with state, auth, and security the hard way.

cards.title: Cart and auth state
cards.description: A cart that syncs across tabs and an auth system that doesn't blow up, both using only the browser's Web Storage APIs.

cards.title: Security from scratch
cards.description: Password hashing, session tokens, CSRF, rate limits. No library doing it for you.

solution.title: The solution: a clean PHP API and a vanilla frontend
solution.description: Strict separation between the two sides. PHP serves the data, the frontend consumes it.

features.title: PHP REST API
features.description: Endpoints for auth (login, register, reset), product CRUD, cart logic and image uploads.

features.title: Vanilla JS frontend
features.description: Responsive UI with Intersection Observer for lazy loading and skeleton screens. No virtual DOM, no framework.

techStack.title: How it's built
techStack.description: The actual stack behind the store.

categories.name: Backend
categories.description: Object-oriented PHP with PDO prepared statements and transactional bulk operations.

categories.name: Security
categories.description: Argon2id password hashing, CSRF tokens, rate limits, account lockouts, input sanitization.

categories.name: Database
categories.description: MySQL with foreign keys, cascading deletes, and indexes on products, variants and sessions.

categories.name: Frontend
categories.description: Semantic HTML, modular ES6, backdrop filters for the look. Open Graph tags and JSON-LD included.

results.title: A working admin panel
results.description: Admin CRUD for products and variants, backed by the same API the store uses.

results.title: The security was real
results.description: Covered the usual OWASP suspects (SQL injection, CSRF, brute force) end to end, without a library.
